verdict.rationale: Docs confirm connectors automatically detect and handle upstream schema changes without breaking pipelines, and alerting features exist to flag issues, but the evidence never describes a configurable policy (e.g., block/allow new columns or tables, pause vs. auto-propagate) that lets the engineer choose how changes are handled. Missing for 10: explicit schema-change-handling policy settings, documentation of user-selectable propagation modes, and independent confirmation that policy choices work reliably in practice.
